messages:
Sam (Sales): Heads up — Enterprise prospect 'Helix Health' just sent a security/compliance questionnaire. Key asks: SOC2 report, HIPAA BA, GDPR data export + deletion, audit log retention and export, KMS/HSM support. I uploaded the questionnaire here: https://files.redwood/helix-security-q1.pdf 

Raj (Support): Got it. I skimmed — lots we can answer with existing collateral but several items require legal/engineering. Pasting redacted bits below that need triage:
```
Q: Do you provide a SOC2 report?
A: [answer]

Q: Do you sign a Business Associate Agreement (HIPAA)?
A: [answer]

Q: Can you support per-tenant audit log retention and S3 export?
A: [answer]

Q: Do you support customer-managed encryption keys?
A: [answer]
```

Tess Nguyen (Product): Triage proposal: 1) Create an intake ticket in product-backlog with the questionnaire attached. 2) Categorize asks into: (1) docs/answerable, (2) small config features (~1 sprint), (3) engineering features (2+ sprints), (4) contractual/legal. 3) Provide immediate customer-facing answers for items in (1) and (2). 4) For feature asks, provide estimates and proposed timelines.

Evan Li (Eng-Security): Quick engineering read:
- SOC2 report: we have a current SOC2 Type II report; we can share redacted copy (docs) — low effort.
- Audit logs: adding per-tenant retention and export to S3 requires schema + retention policy + export job. Engineering estimate: spike 3 days, feature ~3 weeks (1 engineer).
- KMS/CMK (customer-managed keys): we have KMS integration for some artifacts but not full CMK support for model artifacts & embeddings. Estimate ~4 weeks (2 engineers) including key rotation and telemetry.

Priya Shah (Solutions): Customer expectation notes from discovery: they want >1yr retention for logs, ability to push logs to their S3 (private bucket), and a tool for on-demand exports for audits. Also they will ask for a deletion workflow for GDPR (data subject access requests) with sub-30 day SLA.

Maya Ortiz (Legal): HIPAA note: We can sign a BA only for Private deployments or for Hosted with an enterprise amendment — need sales to confirm which deployment they expect. I'll prepare BA language but need to review risk and insurance limits. For GDPR, we have standard data processing addendum; need to confirm the retention timeline with product.

Tess Nguyen (Product): Proposed immediate answers and roadmap mapping:
- Docs: Share SOC2 report and DPA today. (Action: Raj)
- Short-term (target: 6–8 weeks): per-tenant audit retention + S3 export + export UI/CSV API. Acceptance criteria: configurable retention days per org, successful export job to S3, test plan for export.
- Medium-term (target: 4–6 weeks after short-term): customer-managed keys (CMK) for encryption at rest for customer artifacts. Acceptance criteria: KMS integration, key rotation docs, e2e tests.
- Legal/Contractual: BA template & clarification on hosted vs private deployment (lead: Maya).

Tess Nguyen (Product): Roadmap priority: mark audit retention+export P1 for enterprise requests (spike this sprint). CMK as P2. Data residency controls P2. We will not commit to HIPAA-hosted without legal sign-off.

Sam (Sales): I'll tell Helix: we can share SOC2/DPA immediately, retention+export is on roadmap ~6–8 weeks, CMK after that. They asked about timelines today; that's reasonable.

Evan Li (Eng-Security): I'll file a technical spike to validate storage costs and export design. Spike ticket: ENG-8372. Will update by EOD Fri.

Raj (Support): Action: I'll upload SOC2 redacted and DPA to the shared folder and send to customer today. Also creating intake ticket in product backlog: https://jira.redwood/browse/PROD-4921 (attached questionnaire).

Maya Ortiz (Legal): I'll draft BA and share redlines in the doc. If they require HIPAA for hosted, we'll need an enterprise amendment and SLAs — estimate 2 weeks for draft review.

Tess Nguyen (Product): Acceptance criteria block for audit retention feature (copy into ticket):
```
- Per-org retention configurable (in days) in Console or via API
- Retention setting enforced by automated purge job
- Export to S3: manual job + scheduled exports, success/failure logs surfaced
- Tests: export integrity test, restore-from-export sanity check
- Docs: user guide + example terraform for S3 target
```

Priya Shah (Solutions): Confirming export format — JSONL with timestamp and event_type is fine for them. Will coordinate with Evan on schema.

Tess Nguyen (Product): Final decision summary (to include in reply to customer): share SOC2/DPA now; propose retention+export timeline 6–8 weeks (P1); CMK in roadmap after that (P2); BA available for Private deployments / enterprise amendment for hosted (legal to confirm).

Sam (Sales): I'll send that message and include a short note on how this fits our standard enterprise onboarding.

Evan Li (Eng-Security): I'll add the perf/cost notes to the spike. If export frequency is high, we should consider batch windowing to reduce egress.

Tess Nguyen (Product): Action items recap:
- Raj: upload SOC2 + DPA + send to customer (today)
- Raj: create Jira PROD-4921 and attach questionnaire (done)
- Evan: spike ENG-8372 (this week)
- Priya: confirm export schema and acceptance tests (this week)
- Maya: BA draft and redlines (1–2 weeks)
- Sam: customer comms and follow-up on deployment expectations (today)

SupportBot: Ticket PROD-4921 created by raj at 1715001300.

Sam (Sales): Thanks everyone — keep updates in the Jira ticket and tag me on blockers. :thumbsup:
